name: Solaris Resources Inc.
summary: Solaris Resources Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties. It focuses on exploring copper, molybdenum, gold, lead, zinc, and silver. It owns interests in Warintza project located in southeastern Ecuador in the province of Morona Santiago, Canton Limon Indanza; and the Tamarugo project located in northern Chile. The company also holds interests in the La Verde project located in the Sierra Madre del Sur west of Mexico City in Michoacán State, Mexico; and the Capricho and Paco Orco projects in Peru.
